title: KeyRotationSignal
description: Category C — operational projection of the imagodei KeyRotation DHT entry. Source-of-truth for this signal is the DHT-notarized KeyRotation entry referenced by actionHash (imagodei DNA, recovery_v2 integrity zome). The stream message is reconstructable by querying the DNA; it is never persisted as-is. Emitted when commit_key_rotation succeeds and post-commit fires RecoveryV2Signal::KeyRotationCommitted. Translated by HolochainAppSignalStream (Task A.11) into this canonical storage-internal shape.

actionHash.description: Holochain ActionHash (base64) of the KeyRotation DHT entry that originated this signal. Use to verify provenance against the DHT.

agentCid.description: Agent identifier string. Stage 1: populated with human_agent_pubkey (the agent's current ed25519 pubkey, base64) from the KeyRotationCommitted signal. Stage 2: will be a content CID derived from the imagodei Human entry.

newPubkey.description: The incoming ed25519 pubkey (base64, 32 bytes) that replaces the old key.

oldPubkey.description: The rotated-out ed25519 pubkey (base64, 32 bytes). After rotation, content signed by this key must be re-verified against the key rotation chain.

rotatedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the DHT entry records the rotation as having occurred. Derived from the KeyRotation entry's rotated_at Holochain Timestamp field.

emittedAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the signal was emitted from the conductor post-commit hook.
